rules.statement: A mortgagee who has not registered an address for service and has failed to make a subsequent grantees or puisne incumbrancer a party in the action cannot bind such parties through a decree, unless there is evidence of their knowledge and acquiescence.
rules.supporting_quote: "The facts that the plaintiff knew of the pendency of the mortgage action but took no steps, and that he bid at the auction sale, were held not sufficient in the circumstances of this case to constitute an estoppel."
